moments.name: Closing lift
moments.look: The last section uncovers the closing photograph. The photograph settles from a close crop, the line stays at full opacity and only the action fades.
moments.reduced: A plain closing section with the photograph, the line and the action.
moments.phone: The closing photograph follows in ordinary flow. Its line stands at full opacity and its action fades in.

needs.words: a closing line of 3 to 7 words, one line and one action; the closing section of its own, the footer after it
needs.picture: A calm dark lower third under light text, or a solid reading band.

moments.name: Counter rolls
moments.look: The digits of two to four proof figures roll once like an odometer when the row comes on screen, the right-most digit turning most; the strips rest on the real figures before and after, so the row never reads as zeros.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the figures roll once as the row comes on screen.

needs.words: 2 to 4 figures the brief gives (a price, a count, a time), each with a short caption; never an invented outcome

moments.retired: The rolling digits show incorrect figures.

moments.name: Cursor spotlight
moments.look: A soft light on the hero's ground follows the pointer with a short lag and shows a fine dot grid around it; it drifts back to its resting spot when the pointer leaves.
moments.reduced: The light rests at its spot; also on touch screens.
moments.phone: The light rests at its spot; there is no pointer.

needs.words: a hero frame on a lit ground holding the product

moments.retired: The pointer treatment collapses its host.

moments.name: Giant type, picture passing
moments.look: Two to four words set at 12vw with a photograph showing through the letters under a 65% ink tint, dark enough to read over any photograph; the photograph passes upward through the type as the section crosses the screen.
moments.reduced: The photograph stands still inside the letters.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone with the type smaller (19vw) and two thirds of the travel: the photograph still passes up through the letters.

needs.picture: mid to dark tones with detail, no pale sky; the lower half of the picture is what shows
needs.words: a statement of 2 to 4 words and one line under it

moments.name: Headline arrives
moments.retired: Not dealt as a moment: its look (the headline words rising out of masks, 38 ms apart) is one of the hero entrances dealt from the deck (motion.md, The hero's entrance); a moment that also moves the headline would be a second entrance.
moments.look: The hero headline's words rise once out of their masks, 38 ms apart, and settle; the sub-line and the buttons fade up behind them.
moments.reduced: The headline stands as written; nothing moves.
moments.phone: The headline or button stands as written.

moments.name: Iris opens
moments.look: A section that sits on a new ground keeps that ground edge to edge; inside it an inset panel in the old ground (even gutter, card corners, never touching the section's edges) opens a disc in the middle of what is visible, widening with a hairline accent ring at its edge. Each heading, paragraph, button and picture stays hidden until the disc holds all of it, then fades in whole, so no word is ever cut. When the two grounds are too close to tell apart, the panel is moved lighter or darker until the disc reads, and the ring is 2px with a soft shade.
moments.reduced: The section stands on its own ground, no panel, no ring.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the inset panel in the old ground opens its disc as the section rises, each block fading in whole.

needs.grounds: the section sits on another ground than the one before it (ground-inverse, ground-surface)
needs.words: a section of one or two screens with its h2 first

moments.retired: The mask obscures the arriving section.

moments.name: Letters assemble
moments.look: A statement of two to five words, set very large: its letters start scattered, shifted and turned, and fly into the line one after the other as the statement rises through the screen, whole before it reaches the middle.
moments.phone: A lighter version on a phone, in a smaller size: no scrub; the letters start a third as far from home and fly into the line once, in 1.1 s, as the statement comes on screen.

needs.words: a statement of 2 to 5 words (up to about 28 letters) and one or two lines under it

moments.name: Line carries the colour
moments.look: A section that sits on a new ground keeps that ground edge to edge; inside it an inset panel in the old ground (even gutter, card corners, never touching the section's edges) is cleared by a one-pixel accent line that climbs through it from its foot to its top: below the line the section's own ground and words, above it the old ground. Each heading, paragraph, button and picture stays hidden until the line has passed above all of it, then fades in whole, so no word is ever cut. When the two grounds are too close to tell apart, the panel is moved lighter or darker until the change reads, and the line is 2px.
moments.reduced: The section stands on its own ground, no panel, no line.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the accent line climbs through the inset panel as the section rises, each block fading in whole.

needs.grounds: the section sits on another ground than the one before it (ground-inverse, ground-surface)
needs.words: a section of one or two screens with its h2 first

moments.name: Lines rise
moments.look: A content heading rises line by line on first entry, with 90 ms between lines. The surrounding content stays readable. On an older section mount, marked parts follow the heading.
moments.phone: The heading rises line by line once on a phone and on desktop.

moments.name: Liquid hover
moments.look: The pointer pushes a photograph like the surface of water: the picture bends along the pointer's path with a wet shine and a hair of colour split, and the ripple diffuses away in a second or two, back to the plain picture.
moments.reduced: The photograph stands; also on touch screens and without WebGL.
moments.phone: The plain photograph, no canvas, no WebGL context.

needs.picture: The game or creative tool's own picture is the product.

moments.name: Liquid type
moments.look: A very large headline ripples and stretches like type seen through water: one ripple passes through it from left to right each time it comes on screen, the pointer ripples it wherever it crosses the letters, and a tap or a touch drag ripples it at the finger; it settles back to crisp type within about a second. One SVG filter, only while it moves.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone: the ripple passes through the headline as it comes on screen, and a tap or a touch drag ripples it again.

needs.words: a headline of 2 to 6 words, set large

moments.name: Marquee row
moments.look: One row of client words, trades, cities or formats moves slowly sideways in a loop, fading at both edges, the first word whole as it starts; it pauses under the pointer and has a pause button after the row, never over a word.
moments.reduced: The words stand in a wrapped row.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone, slower and with a narrower fade, the pause button after the row.

needs.words: 6 to 14 real words (trades, cities, formats), never logos and never invented clients

moments.name: Photo chapters
moments.look: One photograph gives way to the next while its chapter stays in a reading panel.
moments.reduced: Nothing is pinned: the chapters stand side by side, each photograph over its title and lines, and the section is as tall as they are.
moments.phone: Each photograph flows above its title and description.

needs.words: Three or four chapters, each with a title and two lines.
needs.pictures: one photograph per chapter, all of one place, product or job, none used elsewhere on the page

moments.height: Desktop holds half a screen per chapter plus the stage. Phone chapters take their natural height.

moments.name: Picture develops
moments.look: The photograph develops from grey to colour once, with the film look.
moments.phone: The film look runs on a phone too (one picture, a filter and a transform, once); the print look shows the photograph.

needs.picture: one photograph with a clear subject, half the container wide or more: the section's subject, not a thumbnail

moments.name: Pinned chapters
moments.look: Two steps or short descriptions flow beside their pictures. For a longer sequence each step opens beside a frame sized to its picture or UI.
moments.reduced: Each step stays with its text and complete visual. Desktop uses two columns and phones stack them.
moments.phone: A lighter version on a phone, nothing pinned: each step stands with its title, two lines and its visual under it; the step crossing the middle of the screen takes the accent rule at its left, and each picture settles from a close crop to its framing as it rises.

needs.words: 2 to 4 steps, a title and two lines each
needs.pictures: one picture or screen per step

moments.name: Window parallax
moments.look: One wide photograph seen through a frame moves a little slower than the page, so the frame reads as a window onto a larger picture.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone with two thirds of the travel: the photograph still moves a little slower than the page in its frame.

moments.name: Statement lights up
moments.look: A complete statement stands in readable muted ink. Words take full ink in reading order as the heading crosses the middle of the screen.
moments.phone: The full heading stays in flow with the same change of ink. Reduced motion holds the final colour.

needs.words: One existing statement of 12 to 40 words on a heading.

moments.name: Word rotates
moments.look: A word changes in a fixed-width grid cell inside an h1 or h2. The pause button sits below the heading. Refuse it if the widest alternative changes the line count at 390px.
moments.phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the word changes every two seconds, the pause button under the headline.

needs.words: An h1 or h2 with two to four alternatives in the brief. Refuse it if the widest word changes the line count at 390px.
